findings.message: 6 gradient fill(s): div.hero-blob-a.pointer-events-none → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255, 220, 50, 0.08), rgba(255, 220, 50, 0.08) 35%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)) | div.hero-blob-b.pointer-events-none → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(28, 79, 138, 0.45), rgba(28, 79, 138, 0.45) 35%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)) | div.pointer-events-none.absolute → linear-gradient(to top, oklab(0.231324 -0.0156847 -0.0611215 / 0.3) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 2 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): footer.mt-6.flex 614px | div.pointer-events-none.absolute 1440px rule
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Prefer a filled surface or no box.
One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Cheesecake Ice Cream with graham crust, " 4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Sweet Cream Ice Cream with pecans, brown" 4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Cake Batter Ice Cream with rainbow sprin" 4:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.1:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 49px (3.4vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Sweet moments at Cold Stone." (screen 7, 25% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
